lines.2: I headed to the school gate.
lines.3: Konoe was there alone, taking her turn on duty.
lines.4: 「Huh? Were you always scheduled for the last shift, Konoe?」
lines.5: 「Things got rearranged a few times. It was hectic.」
lines.6: 「I see. I barely came over here at all today.」
lines.7: I'd taken the final shift to make up for that.
lines.9: 「We're not getting any more visitors now, are we?」
lines.10: 「Probably not... but someone has to stay here, even if it's just for form's sake.」
lines.13: 「...The martial-arts tournament's probably at the finals by now.」
lines.15: Subaru and Murata had scored a spectacular double knockout, so I'd lost interest in the tournament after that.
lines.16: 「I can head back once the folk dance starts, right?」
lines.19: 「If you need the bathroom, go ahead. I'll watch the place.」
lines.20: 「I was getting annoyed at the Princess.」
lines.22: 「Doesn't that attitude of hers get on your nerves?」
lines.23: 「Even if there aren't any customers around, a maid shouldn't be standing here fuming.」
lines.25: 「You really are boiling over all year round.」
lines.30: 「I guess I take things too seriously. I can't just let them roll off me.」
lines.31: 「What about you, then? Permanently cooled down?」
lines.33: 「Actually, I might try changing that way of thinking a little.」
lines.35: 「Watching you made me think maybe I could let myself get carried away once in a while.」
lines.37: Konoe stared at me like she couldn't believe what she'd heard.
lines.39: Her twin-tails bounced as she started laughing.
lines.40: 「You finally admit it! Your whole philosophy was rotten!」
lines.42: 「I'm just saying I'll give it some thought from now on.」
lines.45: My core isn't that strong. I can't change overnight.
lines.49: 「Not just because Otome told me to, and not just for show.」
lines.51: 「Talking to you like this is more fun than staying mad at you, Konoe.」
lines.58: 「Fine! If you're going THAT far, I guess I can agree!!」
lines.60: 「Then... about middle school. I went too far back then. Sorry!」
lines.63: 「I might've gone a little too far back then too.」
